content:
Alex: Rolling CUDA 12 toolkit to eu-west GPU fleet finished earlier. Seeing ~6 nodes in g4-pool flapping, pods stuck in CrashLoopBackOff with NCCL errors. Anyone else?
Sasha: Yep saw it. NCCL logs show 'unhandled cudaErrorInvalidDeviceFunction' and driver mismatch. Host driver is 515.x, container toolkit 12 expects 535+. /var/log/kern.log shows 'nvidia: kernel module taint'.
Morgan: Autoscaler already spilling workloads to other zones. We're hitting capacity in us-west and falling back to CPU inference which caused a cost spike. Need a quick plan.
Lee: Quick checks: run `uname -r` and `nvidia-smi -q | grep Driver Version` on an affected node. Could be kernel ABI mismatch after the recent node kernel bump.
Alex: @Sasha I tried modprobe on one node, got 'modprobe nvidia' -> 'Unknown symbol in module'.
Sasha: That confirms symbol/version mismatch. We rebuilt containers for CUDA12 but didn't ensure host driver modules were updated. Two immediate options: (1) force-driver-upgrade to 535+ on nodes, (2) revert containers to toolkit=11.x and redeploy. Option 2 is fastest for the fleet.
Morgan: If we revert images we avoid spinning extra GPUs, but we might still have a few nodes that need driver fixes. Alternative: spin up 4 reserved nodes in eu-west to soak traffic while we fix — rough cost estimate requested.
Lee: Temporary workaround that sometimes helps: bind-mount host libs into container and set LD_LIBRARY_PATH. Ugly but can unblock some processes (doesn't help kernel module mismatches). Example:
```bash
docker run --rm -v /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:/hostlibs -e LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/hostlibs:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH my-inference-image
```
But if module symbols differ, that won't help NCCL/kernel errors.
Oncall: Opened INC-2026-143 and assigned. @Sasha @Alex pls take. infra-bot posted rollout job info.
infra-bot: Deployment job 3245: toolkit-upgrade/eu-west started by Alex. Status: partial-success (6/12 nodes). Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/3245
Sasha: Proposed plan: 1) Pause toolkit rollout (done) 2) Revert images to cuda-toolkit:11.8 tag and trigger canary 3) Queue driver upgrade job for remaining nodes 4) Autoscaler scale plan to avoid CPU fallback. I'll open PR for the image revert now.
Alex: Morgan please quantify reserve spin-up cost so we can decide. Also block further rollouts until we add preflight driver/kernel checks.
Morgan: Estimate for 4 x p4d reserved (24h window) ~2.1k/day. If we need 12h it's ~1.05k. Starting capacity request now.
Lee: Adding a preflight check to the rollout pipeline: `modinfo nvidia | grep vermagic` vs `uname -r` and fail if mismatch. Also log `modinfo nvidia | grep version` into node health report.
Sasha: Also adding runtime logging: launcher will emit `cudaToolkitVersion` and `driverVersion` on startup for every worker to speed up triage.
Alex: Good. I'll coordinate the revert job and post the rollback job ID when live. Thanks everyone.
Morgan: :thumbsup: keeping an eye on costs and capacity.
Sasha: I'll update INC-2026-143 with progress and link PRs.
Alex: Closing the loop here; if you see new flapping nodes ping me.
